data.title: ‘Breaking Bad’ actor RJ Mitte dies, age 34
data.description: RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter “Flynn” White Jr in the acclaimed television series Breaking Bad , has died in Texas, according to a report by US entertainment news outlet TMZ.

data.title: IMF upgrades global growth forecast but warns of 'split' outlook
data.description: BANGKOK - The International Monetary Fund on Tuesday forecast that global growth in 2026 would slow less than previously expected due to advanced economies' "resilience" in the face of war-fuelled energy prices, but warned that low-income countries remained vulnerable to the supply shock.

data.title: The mane event
data.description: Fashion month has always had a funny way of making us reconsider things we thought we knew. A bun is no longer just a bun. Crimped hair might not have to hide solely as a layer. Somewhere between New York and Paris this month, models' manes have stopped behaving entirely.

data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 13
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: The darkest sunrise
data.description: For some, 6.29am on Oct 7, 2023, began like any other day. For many in Israel, it marked the end of their lives and the start of an annual remembrance for those whose lives had ended and changed forever.

data.title: Grounded launches at Scarlette Theatre
data.description: Scarlette Theatre presents Grounded, featuring a single actor on stage, at T. Nam Charoen Playhouse, every Friday to Sunday from Oct 17 to Nov 1.

data.title: Entries open for 'Hackathon Thailand'
data.description: Developers, students, startups and technology builders in Thailand have until Oct 23 to apply for the "Regional Codex Hackathon Thailand", which will take place at Shopee Office, 25th floor of Singha Complex, Phetchaburi Road, on Nov 21 from 8.30am to 9pm.

data.title: Eight districts remain flooded as drainage efforts continue
data.description: Floodwaters have receded in parts of Bangkok, leaving eight districts still affected as authorities continue drainage and cleanup operations.

data.title: Varawut  vows action  over leaks
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa has pledged strict inspections and immediate closure orders for factories breaking the law following a chemical leak from industrial waste in Prachin Buri that, compounded by flooding, has caused damage and hardship for residents.

data.title: PM confident  of coalition bloc's unity
data.description: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul yesterday expressed confidence that the ruling coalition would remain united during the upcoming no-confidence debate, saying he trusted coalition partner Pheu Thai to stand by Bhumjaithai (BJT).

data.title: Buriram, Ratchaburi seek wins
data.description: Hosts Buriram United face a buoyant Beijing FC in the AFC Champions League Elite, with Thailand's two representatives both desperate to arrest troubling runs in the competition.

data.title: Always Lalisa superstar doc screening in  Thai cinemas now
data.description: The documentary film Always Lalisa follows Thai superstar and Blackpink singer Lisa for a year as she pursues her solo career during a break from the group. After premiering at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival in September, the documentary is now showing in Thai cinemas nationwide until Oct 18.

data.title: Act now to avoid next 'great repression', IMF says
data.description: Reforms to boost growth, alongside credible tax and spending plans, could help governments avoid a new wave of financial repression, an International Monetary Fund (IMF) official said on Monday.

data.title: Anutin courts Japanese EV manufacturers
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has invited Japanese automakers to use Thailand as an electric vehicle (EV) production base, pledging to protect the existing automotive industry.

data.title: Youth leaders leave for China
data.description: A delegation of 40 Thai youths is visiting China's Yunnan province for a 13-day study programme focusing on ethnic cultures, agriculture, community-based tourism and cooperation in the Mekong subregion.

data.title: Heavy rain alert  for flooded areas
data.description: The government's Joint Information Centre on Monday urged people in flood-prone areas to monitor conditions closely, with heavy rain forecast in parts of the country from Oct 13-18.

data.title: Designers showcase Thai silk
data.description: Designers from more than 100 countries are showcasing creations made with Thai silk in Bangkok as Thailand hosts the 2026 annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group.

data.title: Air force sets out roadmap  for upgrades
data.description: Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) commander ACM Seksan Kantha has unveiled a 2027-2028 roadmap to strengthen the force's capabilities and safeguard Thailand's airspace and sovereignty under the vision of an "Unbeatable Air Force".

data.title: Thailand has become 'the sick man of Asia': Korn
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij warned that Thailand risks falling into an economic trap, saying the country has gone from being an economic success story to the "sick man of Asia".

data.title: Ekniti pushes AI for all
data.description: Better jobs, stronger skills and broader access to the benefits of AI are Thailand's key priorities as the technology transforms work and business, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: One dead as Hurricane Simon creeps along Mexico's Pacific coast
data.description: PUERTO VALLARTA (MEXICO) - Hurricane Simon killed one person, damaged property and triggered flooding as it inched along Mexico's Pacific coast, authorities said Monday.

data.title: Brazil's patron saint reappears in polarized election campaign
data.description: APARECIDA (BRAZIL) - Thousands of teary-eyed pilgrims paid homage to Brazil's patron saint in the largest shrine in her name on Monday, with a bitter election campaign's battle for the Catholic vote taking center stage.

data.title: Pakistan detains hundreds from ex-PM Khan's party as protests falter
data.description: PESHAWAR (PAKISTAN) - Pakistani authorities have detained hundreds of members of Imran Khan's party, police officials said on Monday, as a protest movement in support of the jailed former prime minister appeared to falter.

data.title: US federal agents search home of Trump critic Ilhan Omar
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US federal agents searched the Washington home of Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar on Monday as part of a criminal investigation, officials said, marking a dramatic escalation in President Donald Trump's confrontation with the outspoken lawmaker.

data.title: Pope to enter hospital for lung operation
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV will be admitted to hospital on Tuesday morning for an operation to remove a lump from his lung, the Vatican said.

data.title: UK retains early access to test latest US AI models
data.description: LONDON - Britain has retained early access to the latest artificial intelligence models for safety testing, the country's AI minister confirmed Monday, following reports that the White House had restricted the UK's access.

data.title: Saudi says resilience tested, vows response after deadly airport attacks
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Saudi Arabia's energy minister on Monday said the country had been tested but would mount a "serious" response after a string of attacks on Riyadh's international airport by Yemen's Houthis that left 18 people dead.

data.title: French supermarket chains say cyberattack forced refrigerator shutdown
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Major French supermarket chains Intermarche and Cooperative U were hit by a cyberattack that caused their refrigerators to defrost, the two retailers reported Monday.

data.title: Top NATO commander warns Russia any attack would be 'futile'
data.description: WARSAW - NATO's top military commander said Monday the alliance would "block, blunt, and break" any attack on its members, in a warning to Russia as fears grow over the threat from Moscow.

data.title: UNHCR sounds alarm on funding crisis
data.description: GENEVA - The UN refugees chief warned Monday about being "asked to do the impossible", with his agency over-stretched by a huge funding shortfall and heavy displacement.

data.title: Stolen Renoir paintings found behind wall in France: prosecutor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Two paintings by impressionist master Pierre-Auguste Renoir, stolen from a museum in southern France and later discovered hidden behind a wall, have sustained slight damage, prosecutors said on Monday.

data.title: France schools protest rumbles on as Macron urges 'respect'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Some 130 French high schools remained closed on Monday, the education ministry said, with authorities hoping the protest movement that has rocked the nation in recent weeks would ease ahead of half-term holidays.

data.title: Americans Hall and Woodford win economics Nobel for stabilisation models
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Americans Robert Hall and Michael Woodford were awarded the Nobel economics prize Monday for their work on how monetary and fiscal policy can better stabilise disruptive economic fluctuations.

data.title: Hurricane Simon lashes Mexico's Pacific coast, threatens US landfall
data.description: MIAMI - Hurricane Simon lashed Mexico's Pacific coast with severe winds and heavy rain on Monday, as it threatens to make landfall in the United States this week, according to the country's National Hurricane Center.

data.title: Zelensky vows to respond as Moscow silent on 'energy ceasefire'
data.description: WARSAW - Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday his country would respond if Russia did not agree to the "energy ceasefire" announced by US President Donald Trump.
